title: GhostClaw Project Registry
description: Validates the project registry YAML that defines the project operating system entries within the SIRINX OS ecosystem.

projects.description: List of registered projects in the operating system.

id.description: Unique project identifier matching the pattern: a hyphenated lowercase slug.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the project.

canonical_role.description: The primary responsibility this project fulfills in the operating system.

priority.description: Relative importance within the OS pipeline.

status.description: Current lifecycle stage of the project.

domain_category.description: The business or technical domain this project belongs to.

constraints.description: Operational constraints or guardrails that apply to this project.

known_routes.description: Routes (task types) that this project is known to use.

path.description: Name or slug of the route.

description.description: What this route handles for the project.

tier.description: Access or sensitivity tier for this route.

domain_pack_rules.description: Domain-specific packaging or routing override rules.

build_order.description: Sequential ordering of build steps for this project.

agent_lanes.description: Agent lanes permitted to operate on this project.

retrieval_keys.description: Keys used to look up this project in the knowledge vault or route matrix.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the project entry was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the project entry was last updated.
